_README: Placements made by hand, keyed by the name the app shows. The pipeline tries these first, so a stop that needs a person's eye is corrected here rather than by editing a script. Each entry needs latitude, longitude, and a method saying why - that method is copied into the shipped row and into docs/stop-review.md. Use `python3 .github/skills/stop-positions/scripts/05_context.py` and read build/stops/05_worklist.json for what is known about each leftover stop.
